Nightly Batch Runbook

This runbook covers the nightly batch window. If a job is still running past its expected finish time, do not restart it blindly — check the staging table first, then escalate to the on-call engineer if the table is incomplete.

Known failures

  • Authentication errors usually mean a rotated credential.
  • Disk-pressure errors on the staging cluster resolve themselves once the previous run's temporary files are reaped.
